items.name: Trazodone Hydrochloride
items.facts: Updated label for Trazodone Hydrochloride (REMEDYREPACK INC.). Boxed warning: WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS and BEHAVIORS Antidepressants increased the risk of suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients in short-term studies. Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening, and for emergence of suicidal thoughts and behaviors [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ] . Trazodone hydrochloride tablets are not approved for use in pediatric patients [see Use in Specific Populations (8.4) ] . WARNING: SUICIDAL THOUGHTS and BEHAVI
items.summary: REMEDYREPACK INC. updated the label for Trazodone Hydrochloride with a boxed warning regarding suicidal thoughts and behaviors in pediatric and young adult patients.

why_it_matters.text: This update matters for safety and labeling teams monitoring boxed warning requirements for antidepressants, citing 5b9f0b60-0c25-4303-88f1-44bcb347bc49@20261012.
